# Elamu Lombok

> Authentic Greek cuisine, warm hospitality, and stunning island ambiance.

At Elamu Lombok authentic Greek cooking meets the beauty of Lombok. It takes a mother's recipes and a menu crafted with love. Heartful hospitality, for you to feel at home. And a Mediterranean House made for hanging out all times of the day and evening.

## Pages

- [Home](https://elamulombok.com/): Experience authentic Greek cuisine in the heart of Lombok. Warm atmosphere, delicious food, and stunning island ambiance at Elamu Lombok.
- [Breakfast Menu](https://elamulombok.com/breakfast-menu.html): Breakfast at Elamu Lombok: Greek yogurt pancakes, shakshuka, benedicts on homemade sourdough, village-style eggs and fresh salads in Kuta, Lombok.
- [Lunch & Dinner Menu](https://elamulombok.com/lunch-dinner-menu.html): Lunch and dinner at Elamu Lombok: moussaka, souvlaki, mezze platters, fresh Lombok seafood, Greek salads, wraps and the famous lamb shank kleftiko.
- [Drinks Menu](https://elamulombok.com/drinks-menu.html): Drinks at Elamu Lombok: specialty coffee, fresh juices, cocktails, premium spirits and a curated wine list in Kuta, Lombok.
- [Dessert Menu](https://elamulombok.com/dessert-menu.html): Dessert at Elamu Lombok: Mama’s favourite tsoureki, kazandibi, nutty cake, Greek yogurt with walnuts and honey, plus digestifs.
